maya (devex): Heads up — sample-app's function-calling tests failing intermittently after auth retry. Node SDK returns tool call as stringified JSON sometimes. Python returns an object. Repro on CI, attaching logs in thread.

kevin (sdk): ack. can you paste a minimal response example?

maya (devex): sure, here's the payload coming back from the runtime in the failing run:```json
{
  "tool": "get_user",
  "result": "{\"id\":123,\"name\":\"Alice\"}"
}
```so the tool.result is a string that itself is JSON.

kevin (sdk): ugh, double-encoded. is that the runtime sending a string or did the SDK reserialize during retry?

simon (eng-runtime): quick take: the runtime emits structured tool outputs as JSON. the auth-retry wrapper in the Node SDK re-reads the response body stream, does a log stringify when debug=true, and then hands the string back into the tool-parsing path. If the SDK's jsonmode/parser already parsed once, that re-stringify+re-parse path ends up leaving a string in the tool payload.

jonah (platform): so parity issue — Node path does this reserialize; Python's requests.flow keeps the parsed dict intact. We need deterministic semantics: tool outputs should be objects when schema expects object.

maya (devex): workaround in sample-app: safeParse helper that does: `if (typeof v === 'string') try JSON.parse(v) catch (_) return v`. added in adapter for now. but we should fix upstream.

kevin (sdk): plan: change retry wrapper: if response.headers['x-jsonmode'] === '1' OR ctx.parsedJson present, preserve parsed body and avoid stringify-for-log on the object path. will open PR with tests.

simon (eng-runtime): also check streaming toolcall path — partial chunks may be collected and concatenated; helpers that coerce early can still see stringy intermediate states. add test for streaming->fncall finalize.

kevin (sdk): I'll add unit tests in both Node and Python SDKs: Node currently lacks a test for auth retry + jsonmode toolcall parity.

maya (devex): created a small failing test in sample-app that reproduces on CI. leaving it there so PR must fix it before merge.

ci-bot: CI: https://ci.redwood/1234/job/func-call-retry-fail — reproducer attached. (PR linked when created)

jonah (platform): can we also add a short doc blurb in the SDK guides about how jsonmode and toolcalling interact with retry wrappers and logs? people keep tripping over it.

maya (devex): yes, i'll draft a 2-paragraph note and link sample-app repro.

kevin (sdk): PR #4123 opened: fix retry wrapper + unit tests for Node + link to sample-app testcase. pinging reviewers.

simon (eng-runtime): reviewing. also will add a runtime header to make it explicit when outputs are already parsed: `X-Redwood-Parsed: 1`. should help other SDKs too.

maya (devex): awesome. thanks everyone. will follow up after PR lands and update the sample-app onboarding checklist so new hires don't hit this.

kevin (sdk): any chance we should also add a helper in devex helpers: `normalizeToolResult(result)` that does idempotent parsing? could be handy for apps.

maya (devex): yes please — but keep it small. we shouldn't normalize silently if a schema expects string. maybe detect schema type first.

jonah (platform): agreed. add to dx-utils and call out in docs.

maya (devex): thanks — closing loop once PR merges. :party_parrot:
